ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. December 2nd 1945
Miss Doris Panyard Muskegan, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. I hope this finds you all well - and surviving your snow-wind storm of a week ago that reached us last Thursday and Friday. Thanks be to God for all.
I am taking the liberty of asking a favor of you that I think you'll take as a compliment too. At all events I want to have you see the photo of one who in many quarters is considered a saint - some day please God to be cannonized, Fr. Pius the stignatic from Foligno. I would appreciate it very much if you would have a simple little frame put on it for us. Its the only one of the kind I have. The smaller one which is also the only one I have but which I think you will like for your prayer book is for Doris.
Hoping that all our friends in Muskegon an vicinity are coming along on the right way physically and spiritually, I beg to remain
Sincerely yours in Christ
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
